correctness.rationale: Averaging commute times over stationary endpoints gives the unordered sum with factor 1/(2M), valid also for irreducible even cycles. For the single exceptional edge the grouped resistance numerator is m(1+t)^2 + 4 sum_{k=1}^{m-1}(m+t-k)k[1+t(m-k)], with m=n-1; symbolic summation reproduces the exact positive factor of (t-1)^2 for arbitrary m≥2. Independently computing the C5 transition characteristic polynomial and using chi''(1)/(2chi'(1)) gives the claimed exact coordinated improvement and 378/95 at epsilon=1/2. Fixed-budget stationarity follows from rotation invariance, and positive and negative second variations come respectively from the normalized scan and the stated perturbation. Even in the nondegenerate interpretation of strict saddle, the symmetric circulant Hessian on the four-dimensional tangent space has two real two-dimensional Fourier blocks, so both signs imply no tangent kernel. For C3 trace zero and strict convexity force both nontrivial eigenvalues to -1/2 on equality, and the diagonal of the resulting stationary-projector formula forces all weights equal. For C4 the bipartite block determinant gives the squared nontrivial eigenvalue; the remaining eigenvalue -1 contributes 1/2 and equality is exactly w0w2=w1w3.
residual_risks: Scans on the fixed-budget simplex mean a one-edge change followed by common normalization; they are not arbitrary two-edge transfers. No full C5 global minimizer is determined.

evidence: Durastante–Gnazzo–Meini fix the stationary distribution. Bini–Meini–Poloni §3 reduce one edge while transferring conductance to endpoint self-loops to keep the degree vector fixed.
broader_coverage.reasoning: The C5 budget perturbation changes degrees, and has no loops. On an odd cycle with fixed budget and stationary measure, prescribed degree sums w_{i-1}+w_i determine all conductances uniquely, so a fixed-stationarity formulation cannot contain the descending direction.

value.rationale: A natural design objective on the simplest cyclic networks gives an exact counterexample to trusting complete one-edge scans. Sharp minimal size, both lower-size optima and an all-length identity distinguish this from an arbitrary numerically observed improvement.
residual_risks: Does not solve global optimization on general weighted cycles or provide an optimization algorithm.
